title: Morocco with Kids – Family Travel Guide & Tips
description: Traveling to Morocco with children? Our family guide covers safety, best destinations, kid-friendly riads, and practical advice.
content:
## Is Morocco Safe for Kids?

Absolutely. Moroccan culture is extremely welcoming to families. Children are adored everywhere you go.

## Best Destinations

- Marrakech: gardens, horse-drawn carriage rides, storytelling in Jemaa el-Fna
- Agafay Desert: gentle camel rides, splash pools, wide-open spaces
- Atlas Mountains: easy hikes, Berber village visits, mule rides

## Family-Friendly Riads

Many riads welcome children and can arrange connecting rooms, baby cots, and early meals.

## What to Pack

- Sun hats and high-SPF sunscreen
- Snacks for long drives
- A baby carrier for uneven medina streets
